profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer at Department of Energy
profile.summary:
• Experience in the Software Development Full Life Cycle Testing phase in the healthcare industry.
• Setup and manage the System Landscape for the Quality environment, where I apply new software upgrades on web based applications and execute migrations of middleware systems like Datastage and Websphere.
• I tested systems using Windows operating systems running on Oracle and Microsoft SQL server database.
• Test Lead experience which includes; coordinating testing activities, distributing work to testers, ensuring the setup of the test environment, reporting status.
• Excellent interpersonal skills, Dependable, Team player, etc.

I can be reached via e-mail crilintam@hotmail.com or by phone (787) 412-7711.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: - Developed web applications, VB/C# .Net MVC, SQL Server 2008/2014, Oracle 10g/11g, JQuery, HTML 5, Bootstrap.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer and Software Tester
positions.description:
- Developed web application using MVC 4.0, JQuery, HTML, JavaScript and CSS. Proficient use of SQL (2008, 2012) and Oracle (10g, 11g). Design and execute multiple test to ensure that the software meet the requirements
established.

•   Execute new software releases and system upgrades within change and release Management Process over using
SQL 2008, CA Workload, IIS7, IBM Infosphere Information Server, WebSphere Application Server and IBM
Sterling.

positions.title: Sr. Software Tester and Software Developer
positions.description:
• Work and manage the System Landscape configuration for the Quality Assurance environment within the collaboration of Security and infrastructure areas.
• Execute migration process and perform Software test to applications servers like Websphere Application Server V7 to V8.5 and Infosphere Datastage V7.5 to V8.7. Participate in the project of QNXT upgrade 5.1.
• Execute new software Releases and system upgrades within Change and release Management Process over Windows Server systems using SQL 2008, CA Workload, IIS7, IBM Infosphere Information Server, Websphere Application Server and IBM Sterling.
• Design and execute System test, Regression Test, Integration test and Stress Test to Software applications.
• Administering the source version control system using VS Team Foundation Server 2013 and Git as a source code Repository.
• Training new resources to maintain the best technical skills for new projects. Development of technical and user manuals. 24/7 On-Call.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Juan, Puerto Rico, Puerto Rico
positions.description:
• Developed web applications, using .Net MVC, JQuery, SQL Server 2005/2008, Oracle 10g and 11g.
• Developed WCF web services. 
• Develop, test and mantain ETL processes using MS SSIS.
• Create automated workflows using CA Workload.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
• Developed web applications using VS 2008/2010, SQL Server 2005/2008.
• Programming and installing new ATM’s (Automated Teller Machine) machines

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed E-Commerce applications using VS 2005/2008 (WCF, C#, JQUERY), SQL Server 2005/2008, Telerik and Crystal Reports.
• Gather Requirements and identify problems to develop business process.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: • Developed Windows applications using VS 2005 (VB.NET), SQL Server 2005, Infragistics and Crystal Reports.

positions.title: DBA
positions.description:
• Manage day-to-day by monitoring and optimize the performance of the databases (SQL 2005, SQL 2003).
• Create procedures for backup and recovery to ensure high availability of corporate business.
• Developed web applications using VS 2005 and SQL 2005.
• Monitor and test system performance over Windows and Linux Servers.
